images.visual_review: Previously viewed whole identical PNG; SHA verified again

visual_findings.photo: Both matched arms erase fine parachute cords and soften fine cloud/building details; no meaningful detail gain. V61 loses photographic SSIM and PSNR.
visual_findings.GFX: Quiet sky; smoothed truss, leaves and chain-link crossings remain. No clear native improvement over V60. IndependentISO100/aperture/motion prevent pixelwise GT scoring.
visual_findings.paired: Strong noise removal; known edges/plates and unseen brown fields remain smooth; qualitative AHD has independent demosaicing and registration errors.
visual_findings.analytic: Dark fine carrier mostly absent. V61 middle-gray period16 carrier visibly weaker than exactGT and has lower in-phase gain than V60.
visual_findings.other_cameras: Q2 rock and Sony fuselage are soft. GFX50R retains more wall texture than RawNIND but also visible grain; no broad real-camera superiority.
visual_findings.CPU_colors: Neutral close; warm has low frequency variation; cyclic magenta mottled; cyan smoother. Exact analyticGT.
visual_findings.CUDA_grid: V61 gray smooth, selected warm close, magenta still shifted/mottled. Three fixed previews do not span the 1176 cases.

scope: Intermediate single-seed loss-only comparison. All41logged step/domain/LR/input hashes match V60. No general color fix, convergence, protected-final, SOTA, camera superiority or10second claim. KeepV43 working reference; preserve all old releases and model worktree.
